title: Submit support cases from your workspace with the Get support form
body: You can now open a Databricks support case from your workspace with the Get support form. The form fills in issue details, attaches diagnostic files, and suggests an AI-generated solution before you submit. See [Submit a Databricks support case from your workspace](/aws/en/resources/submit-support-case-in-product).
